note: Status 'runnable' means the test can run on 0.1.0. 'waiting on the owner' means it needs an answer or a file the owner has not supplied.

evals.name: answer: positioning is not decided
evals.prompt: What is Wugweb's positioning line? I need it for the About page.
expected: Says the positioning line is not decided and the owner will supply it
Lists the lines in use with their status, without choosing one
Does not use 'Creative UX Design Agency'
Cites references/identity-and-positioning.md

evals.name: answer: values are not the principles
expected: Says values are not decided and the owner will supply them
May list the ten principles, labelled as principles and not as values
Does not derive a values list

evals.name: answer: fixed rule with its file
evals.prompt: How much yellow can I use on a service page banner?
expected: States yellow is an accent at 10% or less, reserved for the one conversion action and the footer banner
Gives no colour value and points to wugweb-kits for values
Cites one reference file

evals.name: visual check: AI brain
evals.prompt: Check this blog hero brief: a glowing blue AI brain made of circuit lines in the centre, with the headline 'Smarter products with AI' set inside the image.
expected: Result fail
Names the banned motifs: AI brain, circuitry, glowing blue technology
Flags text inside the artwork for a blog hero
Proposes a fix through the Intelligence metaphor
Says only a brief was judged, not a rendered image

evals.name: visual check: two modes mixed
evals.prompt: Check this LinkedIn card brief: a dense connector grid with nodes across the whole canvas, three phone mockups, a large poster headline and a collage of four portraits. Topic: our brand workshop offer.
expected: Result fail
Says more than one visual mode is blended and names them
Flags connectors used as texture when the subject is not a system
Flags no single anchor and too many devices
Fix removes elements; it does not add any

evals.name: visual check: clean brief
evals.prompt: Check this case-study cover brief for a transit app: one oversized rounded circle as the anchor, a monochrome hand holding the project's real route card screen through a rounded mask, one yellow marker dot, a lot of empty space, title outside the image.
expected: Result pass
Names one mode, product proof or editorial
Confirms the cover shows a project-specific object
Notes the mask must not hide the part that proves the claim

evals.name: cover rule
evals.prompt: Is this cover on brand? A laptop on a desk showing a generic analytics dashboard, for our fintech case study.
expected: Result fail
Names the cover rule: a project-specific object or outcome, never a generic laptop or dashboard

evals.name: fact check: 400+ projects
evals.prompt: Fact check this bio: 'WugWeb is a Creative UX Design Agency founded in 2020 with 400+ projects delivered across six pillars.'
expected: '400+ projects' marked unverified, with the note that 200+ also appears
'Creative UX Design Agency' marked stale
'founded in 2020' marked unverified
'six pillars' marked approved
'WugWeb' spelling flagged as unverified
No number is softened or replaced
